text: {"lessons":["Large gains in one holding can justify reviewing its portfolio weight, but I should not sell solely because the gain looks impressive.","Selling part of Stock D let me realize some gains while keeping exposure; I should make such choices according to a plan, not short-term price moves.","My account has had both sharp rises and declines, so I should stay focused on long-term goals, diversification, and a risk level I can tolerate."]}
